name: Free France (1940–1944)
description: The French tricolor charged at the centre of the white stripe with a red Cross of Lorraine.
history: Flag of Free France, the movement General de Gaulle proclaimed from London on 18 June 1940; the Cross of Lorraine — emblem of Joan of Arc's homeland — marked Free French forces until the Liberation.

features.symbolism: the double-barred cross chosen by de Gaulle's Free French as the answer to the swastika
